headline: 일상에, 싱그러움을
videoPrompt: A cinematic premium shampoo advertisement in one continuous five-second shot. Starting from the provided product photograph, quickly pull the camera back as a soft out-of-focus green leaf sweeps across the foreground, revealing the exact bottle standing on a wet dark stone beside a shallow forest pool. By second 1.5 the white studio background has transformed completely into a lush atmospheric emerald forest with luminous warm morning sunbeams through moving leaves, delicate mist and golden bokeh. Gentle water ripples reflect dancing light onto the green bottle. The camera moves in a restrained smooth lateral dolly creating clear foreground and background parallax; a few tiny water droplets glisten on the bottle. End by holding a beautiful stable product hero shot for the final 1.5 seconds, surrounded by emerald foliage and warm sunlight. Product remains the only bottle, upright, fully visible and sharp, about 65 percent of frame height with generous breathing space. Precisely preserve the original green bottle silhouette, black pump, gold collar and existing label. Photoreal luxury beauty cinematography, rich deep green shadows and warm gold highlights, realistic physics. No added text, titles, subtitles, new lettering, logos, people, hands, duplicated bottles or bottle morphing.
